reference_sql:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT campaign_id, channel_id, spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * spend / SUM(spend) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_id), 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_spend
alternatives:
WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
channel_spend AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend) AS total_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.campaign_id, cs.channel_id, cs.spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * cs.spend / ch.total_spend, 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN channel_spend ch ON ch.channel_id = cs.channel_id

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
)
SELECT cs.campaign_id, cs.channel_id, cs.spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * cs.spend / (SELECT SUM(cs2.spend) FROM campaign_spend cs2 WHERE cs2.channel_id = cs.channel_id), 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_spend cs

WITH campaign_spend AS (  -- one row per campaign with spend
  SELECT c.campaign_id, c.channel_id, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY c.campaign_id, c.channel_id
),
channel_spend AS (  -- one row per channel with spend
  SELECT channel_id, SUM(spend) AS total_spend
  FROM campaign_spend
  GROUP BY channel_id
)
SELECT cs.campaign_id, cs.channel_id, cs.spend,
       ROUND(100.0 * cs.spend / ch.total_spend, 2) AS share_pct
FROM campaign_spend cs
JOIN channel_spend ch ON ch.channel_id = cs.channel_id
other_way.tradeoff: Channel totals in a step of their own, joined back, give the same shares without a window, at the cost of a join.
